_meta.additive_contract: Purely additive overlay. Does NOT modify assets/data/domains/defense.json or any existing defense file. References existing Defense node IDs and issue IDs by value only. Mirrors the Finance/Energy neuro-substrate overlay shape for the Defense domain.
_meta.advisory_only: This overlay is ADVISORY. It classifies existing authored circuits against the source document's Part XIV failure taxonomy and runs the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test. It writes nothing back and changes no live behavior on load.

heterogeneity_flagged: INVASION — UNMAPPED. The issue IS an external adversarial/agentic attack ('Foreign military incursion into sovereign territory'). None of the 9 Part XIV classes (all E/I-dynamics archetypes: excitation, inhibition, gating, clearance, synchrony, propagation) expresses an intelligent EXTERNAL AGENT attacking the system. This is the Defense analog of Finance's FRAUD_SCANDAL heterogeneity: a failure archetype the neuro-substrate taxonomy structurally cannot represent. The canonical node cue CeA[Hyper] 'hair-trigger=false-alarm' describes the DEFENDER's salience response, not the exogenous attack; classing on that cue would misrepresent the issue. Marked UNMAPPED rather than force-fit.

CYBER_ATTACK — UNMAPPED. 'Coordinated digital assault... adversary code disrupting command-and-control routing' is a DELIBERATE adversarial signal-corruption / network-compromise failure. This is the same unmappable family as Finance FRAUD_SCANDAL (fabricated/corrupted signal injected by an adversary): the 9 classes are dynamical-failure archetypes and none expresses an intelligent adversary injecting corrupted signals. A naive read would force-fit GATING_FAILURE (corrupted routing) or DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME (the canonical cue PAG[Hypo] 'defensive kill/lockdown — no-stop'); both would be a guess about a mechanism the taxonomy cannot hold. Marked UNMAPPED per discipline.

NUCLEAR_THREAT and CIVIL_UNREST — share the identical canonical cue vmPFC[Hypo] 'top-down inhibitory brake — brake-fail=rogue', the same cue Finance CURRENCY_COLLAPSE used, so both class as DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME on the node cue. Their SUMMARIES carry an adversarial/internal-conflict flavor (nuclear brinkmanship; civil instability) that the loss-of-brake mechanism does not fully capture; divergence recorded per issue rather than resolved by guessing.

INVASION, CYBER_ATTACK, LOGISTICS_COLLAPSE — their CANONICAL single-node circuits (CeA; PAG; THAL) are bare non-regulatory nodes that would FAIL the incomplete-circuit test in isolation. The _authored multi-node circuits supply the regulatory partner, so the test passes on _authored/circuits. Observation recorded per issue.

ADVERSARIAL SHARE: 2 of 6 Defense issues (33%) are UNMAPPED adversarial/agentic-conflict failures. This is EXPECTED and ACCEPTED: Defense is adversarial-heavy (war, attack, arms-race, insurgency) and carries more of the unrepresentable-archetype load than Finance (which had 1 of 6, FRAUD_SCANDAL). The remaining 4 issues express internal-regulation failures (disinhibition, gating) that the taxonomy does hold.
_meta.honesty_note: Mechanisms, failure-mode classes, parameters, and references below are verbatim-grounded in the source document. Per-node / per-edge Defense-specific assignments the document gives no basis for (which edge is which inhibitory motif, which oscillatory band, which neuromodulator, which predictive direction) are NOT guessed here; only the two operations the source document directly supports are performed: (1) classify each authored issue against the Part XIV failure taxonomy where the issue's own text names a matching mechanism, marking adversarial/agentic failures UNMAPPED, and (2) run the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Inhibition tracks excitation on a millisecond timescale; balance sets gain, dynamic range, timing precision, and stability. Loss of inhibition -> runaway (seizure); excess -> silence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Any faithful mapping must have inhibition/brakes that SCALE WITH DRIVE.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Four inhibitory motifs
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: feedforward (narrow temporal window / coincidence), feedback/recurrent (self-limiting, gain control, stability), lateral (contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening), disinhibition (inhibiting an inhibitor = permissive gating/selection).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: All four are reused at every scale; their absence breaks the fractal.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Oscillations & communication-through-coherence
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Rhythms create periodic windows of excitability; groups that oscillate coherently open input/output windows at the same time and communicate; incoherent groups are functionally disconnected. Bands: delta 1-4, theta 4-8, alpha 8-12, beta 13-30, gamma 30-80+ Hz.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Coherence = a dynamic routing/connection switch. There is an OPTIMAL coupling band; too-strong and too-weak coupling both fail.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Thalamocortical gating
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Thalamus + TRN gate what reaches cortex; tonic (faithful relay) vs burst (detection/alerting) modes under corticothalamic top-down control.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Gating must occur AT THE RIGHT STAGE - filter too early (before the circuit that needs the signal) and you lose information you cannot recover.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Predictive coding / prediction error
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hierarchical generative machine: top-down predictions descend, bottom-up prediction ERRORS ascend, only the mismatch propagates upward. Laminar correlate: forward = error, backward = prediction.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: 'Prediction error drives update' must also GENERATE predictions at the mapped scale, not merely react.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Plasticity / learning rules
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hebbian (correlated -> strengthen); STDP (pre-before-post ~+10 ms -> LTP, post-before-pre -> LTD; dopamine extends LTP window to ~+30 ms); LTP/LTD (NMDA/Ca2+); homeostatic scaling (global normalization keeping drive in range so Hebbian learning does not run away); metaplasticity (threshold for change adapts).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A stabilizing counter-process (homeostatic scaling) MUST counter positive-feedback Hebbian learning, or the system runs away.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Neuromodulation & gain
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Diffuse systems (DA, NE, 5-HT, ACh) carry no detailed content; they set global regime - gain, signal-to-noise, exploration/exploitation, learning rate, arousal. A small modulatory signal reconfigures the whole network's operating point.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A small broadcast signal must be able to rescale the whole system's operating point (one-to-many, multiplicative).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Population & attractor dynamics
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Information lives in distributed population activity, not single cells; sparse coding is efficient/separable; attractor dynamics implement stable states and transitions. Over-gating, over-synchrony, or lost inhibition suppress emergence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Emergence requires distributed, sparse, inhibition-balanced activity; do not concentrate all state in one node.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Sleep, homeostasis & offline processing
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Sleep down-scales synapses globally while consolidating select memories, and drives glymphatic clearance of waste.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A mandatory OFFLINE maintenance/reset phase - a system with no downtime accumulates damage.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Signal termination / clearance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Reuptake, enzymatic degradation, and diffusion bound signal persistence; termination is as important as release and prevents excitotoxic accumulation.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Clearance/termination must bound signal persistence; a signal that isn't cleared becomes toxic (see failure mode EXCITOTOXICITY).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Refractoriness / dead-time rate limiter
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Absolute refractory period (~1-2 ms) after an action prevents a second action; enforces one-way propagation and caps maximum firing rate.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A built-in rate limiter / dead-time after action must exist to cap throughput and enforce directionality.

inhibitory_motifs_catalog.definition: Input excites both a target and an interneuron that inhibits the target -> narrow temporal window (coincidence-detection, AND within a time window).
Output feeds back through interneurons -> self-limiting, gain control, stability.
Active units suppress neighbors -> contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening.
Inhibiting an inhibitor -> permissive gating / selection.

failure_modes.definition: E/I balance failure: runaway recurrent excitation when inhibition is insufficient. Archetypal no-brakes -> runaway.
Excessive drive with failed termination/clearance -> overload -> death of the unit.
A slow wave of depolarization then silence; homeostatic overwhelm.
Thalamocortical/TRN gating breakdown: too little filtering -> flooding, or mis-timed gating -> wrong information passed; gate stuck closed -> starvation.
Losing the inhibitor releases pathological activity (loss of the stop/brake).
Over-coupling (hypersynchrony) or under-coupling; both degrade communication.
Aggregation + failed clearance + network collapse; maintenance failure compounding over time.
Losing input disables not just the lesioned node but distant connected regions. THE NETWORK, NOT THE NODE, IS THE UNIT OF FAILURE; failures propagate across the graph.

A circuit built without its regulatory partner is intrinsically dysfunctional (fear acquisition without extinction; excitation without matched inhibition; feedback without the sensor). THE DIRECT DIAGNOSTIC FOR A BROKEN FRACTAL MAPPING: if the mapping omits the inhibitory/feedback/extinction arm, it is lesioned in the same way a brain is.

INVASION.reason: Adversarial/agentic-conflict failure with NO analog among the 9 Part XIV classes.
INVASION.defense_text: summary: "Foreign military incursion into sovereign territory requiring full-spectrum defense mobilization across ground, air, naval, and cyber domains"; canonical circuit CeA[Hyper]: "phasic fear output — hair-trigger=false-alarm"
INVASION.reasoning: The issue IS an external intelligent AGENT attacking the system (a foreign military invading). The 9 Part XIV classes are all dynamical-failure archetypes (excitation, inhibition, gating, clearance, synchrony, propagation); none expresses an exogenous adversary attacking. Forcing it into any of the 9 would be a guess. Marked UNMAPPED per discipline.
INVASION.note: The canonical node cue CeA[Hyper] 'hair-trigger=false-alarm' describes the DEFENDER's salience/fear response (a false-alarm flavor), NOT the attack itself. Classing on that cue would misrepresent the issue. This is the Defense analog of Finance's FRAUD_SCANDAL heterogeneity.

CYBER_ATTACK.reason: Adversarial/agentic signal-corruption failure; same unmappable family as Finance FRAUD_SCANDAL.
CYBER_ATTACK.defense_text: summary: "Coordinated digital assault targeting critical infrastructure, military networks, and government systems, potentially disabling defense capabilities without kinetic action"; canonical circuit PAG[Hypo]: "defensive kill/lockdown — no-stop"; _authored FPN[Altered]: "Cyber warfare networks compromised with adversary code disrupting command-and-control routing"
CYBER_ATTACK.reasoning: The named mechanism is a DELIBERATE adversary injecting corrupted code and disrupting/falsifying signal routing. This is the same information-integrity / adversarial-deception family that Finance FRAUD_SCANDAL flagged as structurally unrepresentable: the 9 classes are dynamical-failure archetypes and none expresses an intelligent adversary corrupting the signal. Forcing it would be a guess.
CYBER_ATTACK.note: A naive read would force-fit GATING_FAILURE (corrupted routing) or DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME (canonical cue PAG[Hypo] 'no-stop'); the 'no-stop' describes the DEFENDER's runaway lockdown response, not the adversarial attack. Marked UNMAPPED per discipline. THIS + INVASION are the two adversarial-archetype findings the E/I taxonomy cannot hold.

NUCLEAR_THREAT.subtype: brake-fail -> rogue runaway (loss of the stop/brake)
NUCLEAR_THREAT.defense_text: canonical circuit vmPFC[Hypo]: "top-down inhibitory brake — brake-fail=rogue"; _authored vmPFC[Hypo]: "Arms control frameworks collapsed, removing cooperative restraint mechanisms"; summary: "Escalation to potential nuclear conflict through brinkmanship, proliferation... or failure of deterrence doctrine"
NUCLEAR_THREAT.reasoning: The canonical cue explicitly names the loss of the top-down INHIBITORY BRAKE ('brake-fail=rogue'), and the _authored circuit names the removal of cooperative restraint (arms-control collapse). Losing the inhibitor and releasing rogue/runaway activity is the exact DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME definition (loss of the stop/brake). Identical cue to Finance CURRENCY_COLLAPSE.
NUCLEAR_THREAT.note: The SUMMARY frames it partly as adversarial 'brinkmanship' (a two-actor arms-race dynamic) which the loss-of-brake mechanism does not fully capture; divergence flagged, not resolved by guessing. Classed on the strong, verbatim canonical cue (brake-fail).

INTELLIGENCE_FAILURE.subtype: misdirected attentional gate -> threat-relevant signal filtered out (strategic surprise)
INTELLIGENCE_FAILURE.defense_text: circuit DAN[Hypo-active]: "Intelligence collection missed critical indicators due to attention directed at wrong targets"; circuit VAN[Hypo-active]: "Special operations unable to redirect toward emerging threats due to insufficient early warning"; summary: "Catastrophic failure to detect, analyze, or communicate strategic threats, resulting in strategic surprise"
INTELLIGENCE_FAILURE.reasoning: The named mechanism is an ATTENTIONAL/GATING failure: attention directed at the wrong targets filters out the threat-relevant signal, which is then unrecoverable (strategic surprise). This is the GATING_FAILURE archetype (mis-timed/mis-directed gating -> wrong information passed; filter drops the signal the downstream circuit needed). Unlike INVASION/CYBER_ATTACK, this names the DEFENDER's own detection dynamics failing, which the taxonomy does hold.
INTELLIGENCE_FAILURE.note: INTELLIGENCE_FAILURE is the only issue with no _authored block; its `circuits` array is used (matching the is._authored||is.circuits fallback). It is also the only contract with catchAllBlocked:false (the catch-all-eligible diagnosis).

LOGISTICS_COLLAPSE.defense_text: canonical circuit THAL[Hypo]: "gating relay / routing — stuck-closed=starvation"; _authored CBLM[Hypo]: "Supply coordination breaks down with stockpiles depleted and resupply routes severed"; _authored M1[Hypo]: "Ground forces combat effectiveness degrades as ammunition, fuel, and equipment run out"
LOGISTICS_COLLAPSE.reasoning: The canonical cue names a routing GATE stuck closed producing downstream starvation, verbatim the GATING_FAILURE archetype (gate stuck closed -> starvation). The _authored circuit is definitionally supply starvation (severed routes, depleted stockpiles). Strongest grounding of the set; mirrors Finance BANKING_CRISIS/CREDIT_FREEZE (GP output-gate lock -> starvation).
LOGISTICS_COLLAPSE.note: THAL[Hypo] canonical single node is non-regulatory and would fail the incomplete-circuit test in isolation; _authored supplies CBLM/HYPO regulatory partners.

CIVIL_UNREST.subtype: brake-fail -> rogue runaway (loss of the stop/brake)
CIVIL_UNREST.defense_text: canonical circuit vmPFC[Hypo]: "top-down inhibitory brake — brake-fail=rogue"; _authored CeA[Hyper]: "Civil defense systems activated for domestic crisis but risk escalating confrontation with civilians"; _authored vmPFC[Altered]: "Value-based decision-making conflicted between order maintenance and rights protection"
CIVIL_UNREST.reasoning: Same canonical cue as NUCLEAR_THREAT: loss of the top-down inhibitory brake ('brake-fail=rogue') releasing over-reactive (rogue) activity — the defense apparatus over-responding to civilians when restraint fails. This is DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME (loss of the stop/brake).
CIVIL_UNREST.note: The SUMMARY carries an internal-instability flavor ('balance civil order with civil liberties') that the loss-of-brake cue captures as the restraint arm failing; divergence between the internal-conflict framing and the pure disinhibition cue is flagged.

incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._test: Part XIV: does each issue's authored circuit contain a regulatory/inhibitory/feedback partner from the REGULATORY_NODES set in energy-neuro-substrate.js (vmPFC, dlPFC, OFC, STN, GP, HIPP, HYPO, dACC, CBLM)? Run against defense.json _authored circuits, matching the JS validateIncompleteCircuit() behavior (uses issue._authored||issue.circuits node list). INTELLIGENCE_FAILURE has no _authored, so its `circuits` array is used.
incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._verdict_summary: PASS (6/6). Every authored circuit includes at least one regulatory/feedback node; none is a bare excitatory/reactive driver without its brake. Same headline result as Finance and Energy (6/6). NOTE: three issues (INVASION, CYBER_ATTACK, LOGISTICS_COLLAPSE) have CANONICAL single-node circuits (CeA, PAG, THAL) that are bare non-regulatory nodes and WOULD fail the test in isolation; the _authored multi-node circuits supply the regulatory partner. INDEPENDENCE NOTE: INVASION and CYBER_ATTACK are structurally COMPLETE here yet UNMAPPED in the failure-class map — a circuit can pass the incomplete-circuit test and still express a failure archetype (adversarial attack) outside the 9-class taxonomy. The two diagnostics are independent.

INTELLIGENCE_FAILURE.observation: No _authored block; `circuits` array used. dlPFC is the only regulatory partner present.

rows.parameter: Gut serotonin fraction of body total

parameter_table.ratio_preservation_rule: When mapping any neural time constant to a domain equivalent, hold the RATIOS between constants fixed, not just individual values. The ~1000x gap between AP duration (~1 ms) and slow neuromodulatory/hormonal feedback (~seconds-minutes) is the 'fast signal vs slow modulation' invariant; the Defense mapping must preserve an analogous fast-action / slow-governance separation (e.g. tactical kinetic response vs strategic/treaty-cycle governance), or the fractal is cosmetic, not structural.
